_comment: Bangladesh RMG industry updates shown on the Insights page. Edit this file to update the bar. Newest first. Keep 4-8 items, each linking to a real published source.

items.text: Bangladesh now holds 69 of the world's 100 highest-rated LEED-certified factories, including 18 of the top 20
RMG exports reached USD 3.89 billion in a single month, up 14.7% on the previous month
284 garment factories in Bangladesh are now LEED certified, of which 121 are Platinum rated and 144 Gold
Garment exports rose 11% year on year to USD 10.10 billion in the April to June quarter
A record 38 new LEED-certified green factories were added in a single year, 22 of them Platinum rated
Net export value rose to 62% of earnings, up from 57% a year earlier, as local backward linkage deepens
